projects.title: Numera Calculator Platform
projects.description: A production-grade multi-mode (Standard, Scientific, Advanced) calculator built on Next.js 16 with a pure-TypeScript math engine using Decimal.js for arbitrary-precision arithmetic and a Prisma + SQLite backend for history and recovery.

projects.title: Glassmorphic Digital Clock
projects.description: A reusable, config-driven custom element (<digital-clock>) with glassmorphism styling, animated gradient borders, image/slideshow/neon backgrounds and full IANA timezone and locale support, usable with zero build step.

projects.title: Motefield
projects.description: A tiny, dependency-free 2D-canvas particle field library with first-class support for custom icons and symbols (emoji, text, images, inline SVG and custom draw functions), plus five built-in presets and pointer interaction modes.

projects.title: snow-effect-js
projects.description: A lightweight, zero-dependency canvas snow effect with low CPU/RAM/GPU use, supporting custom symbols, emoji, images and shapes falling in any direction. Also powers the festive snowfall on this portfolio.
